problem_statement: When device_init() is called on a deferred (lazily-initialized) device whose initialization function returns an error, the call returns the positive errno value instead of the negative one. It should follow the convention that a failing initialization returns -errno (e.g. -EIO) so that callers can detect the failure. The recorded error in the device state stays positive; only the return value to the caller is wrong. A second device_init() on the same device correctly returns -EALREADY because the device is already marked initialized.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/kernel/device -s tests/kernel/device/kernel.device -s kernel.device -O twister-out --no-clean -W
